reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is about $1 a serving, when Nature Made or Double Wood cost me $0.20-0.40. It is also a brand I have never heard of with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I stick with Pure Encapsulations, Thorne or Nature Made.
